import numpy as np

def reverse_diffusion(x_t, t, model, alpha_bar, beta):
    alpha = 1 - beta
    epsilon_pred = model(x_t, t)
    coef1 = 1.0 / np.sqrt(alpha[t])
    coef2 = (1 - alpha[t]) / np.sqrt(1 - alpha_bar[t])
    x_prev = coef1 * (x_t - coef2 * epsilon_pred)
    if t > 0:
        sigma = np.sqrt(beta[t])
        x_prev += sigma * np.random.randn(*x_t.shape)
    return x_prev
